episode.title: Something Is WRONG With This TEA BAG

synopsis: A man discovers a teabag that, when opened, reveals a tiny, impossibly deep living ecosystem complete with miniature plants and flowing water.
narration: Just making my morning tea, same routine. But opening this teabag, I saw something truly wild inside. It's like a whole other world.

shots.prompt: A small, square paper teabag, white with a familiar crimped edge, one thread with a paper tag attached, and one side already carefully cut open to reveal an impossibly deep, miniature verdant landscape. The interior of the teabag opens into an infinitely deep, self-contained miniature ecosystem, featuring living, microscopic flora, impossibly clear flowing water, and a palpable sense of vastness within its tiny paper confines. A close-up view of the teabag on a dark speckled stone-look counter, with hands interacting with the opening. A lived-in home kitchen counter: dark speckled stone-look surface with faint scratches and a few crumbs near the edge, a tiled backsplash behind, and morning daylight from a side window mixing with a warm under-cabinet glow. A small, white paper teabag is already cut open on a dark speckled stone-look counter, revealing a vibrant, miniature, living landscape inside, with tiny green plants and a visibly flowing stream of water far below its opening. The view stays in one unchanging position and angle for the whole shot.
shots.violation_observation: The cut-open teabag reveals a vibrant, miniature, living landscape inside, with tiny green plants and a visibly flowing stream of water far below.
